Proposition
[Common powers and commutation] 1. Proposition 5.4.3\group PSL algebraSource: thurston:page-0107 If non-elliptic isometries satisfy $a^n=b^m\ne 1$ for nonzero integers $n,m$, then $a$ and $b$ commute. If $a$ is hyperbolic and $a^k$ is conjugate to $a^l$, then $k=\pm l$.
